title: Containment of Fourier failure sets
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ be real, and let $\tau_n=2\sqrt n\,2^{-n/2}$. For a Boolean-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, write $f_{\mathbb R}$ for its real-valued indicator and $\widehat f_{\mathbb R}(S)$ for its Fourier coefficient at $S$. If either $|\widehat f_{\mathbb R}(\varnothing)-p|>\tau_n$ or some nonempty coordinate set $S$ satisfies $|\widehat f_{\mathbb R}(S)|>\tau_n$, then there is a coordinate set $S$ such that
\[
\left|\widehat f_{\mathbb R}(S)-\begin{cases}p,&S=\varnothing,\\0,&S\ne\varnothing\end{cases}\right|\ge\tau_n.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
Either the empty-set Fourier coefficient differs from $p$ by more than $\tau_n$, or a nonempty-set Fourier coefficient has absolute value greater than $\tau_n$
